title: The Weather of the reservoir
author: Quentin Zhou
blurb: Odile Thornbury, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
